estimate_method: Independent Poisson goal model: expected goals assigned per team from a qualitative assessment of underlying strength, home advantage, recent performance and player availability (small three-game samples given limited weight); home/draw/away and BTTS probabilities derived from independent Poisson goal distributions, BTTS approximated as (1-e^-home_xg)(1-e^-away_xg). Judgment-based inputs, not empirically fitted -- Codex's own stated caveat.
